title: Size and shape
description: Say how big something is and what shape it is.
grammar: gender and articles, and the words for size
grammarNote: An adjective that describes a size goes straight after the noun, with no article in between.

explanation.summary: Size and shape are the first things you say about an object, and they are ordinary adjectives and nouns.

sections.heading: The nouns
sections.body: El tamaño, el peso and el largo are masculine. La medida and la altura are feminine. El largo means the length of a thing, and la altura means how tall it is. La medida is also what you do when you measure something.

sections.heading: The adjectives
sections.body: Largo, corto, ancho, estrecho, redondo and cuadrado all describe a shape or a size, and they go straight after the noun: una mesa redonda, un artículo estrecho. Es and está both work: la mesa es redonda means the table is round, and la mesa está sucia means the table is dirty.

items.note: The feminine es larga: una calle larga.

drills.note: The feminine of redondo es redonda.
The first blank needs La: la calle.
